nodes.name: Leer resultados (MT4)
nodes.notes: Lee mt4-bridge/orders/results/*.json (glob). Devuelve 0 items si no hay ninguno — no falla.

parameters.query:
WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE signals SET
    status = CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN 'OPEN' ELSE 'PENDING_MANUAL' END,
    mt4_ticket = $3, updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM updated) AS updated_count, (SELECT signal_uid FROM signals WHERE id = $1) AS signal_uid;

nodes.name: Actualizar status: OPEN/PENDING_MANUAL
nodes.notes: UPDATE idempotente (mismo patrón que 'Actualizar status: CONFIRMED'): solo actualiza si status='CONFIRMED', evita reprocesar.
